question: Which point in positions.txt does the map draw a province's resource icons at, and what is it where the file declares none?

addresses.name: UpdateProvinceResourcePictures
addresses.comment: **Makes every province's resource icons.** For each index i from 1 below the count of the vector at the argument's +0x2C/+0x30 (the province graphics): ProvinceGraphics_UpdateResourcePictures and then ProvinceGraphics_UpdateStrategicResourcePicture, each given the vector's entry i, g_CCurrentGameState +0xB8C[i] (the province) and [0x1A855FC] (the owner). Makes g_CCurrentGameState first where it is null, as other readers do. One direct caller, CInGameIdler::Enter at 0x65C02E, so the icons are made as a session comes up from what the provinces produce then. `ret 4`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-resourceicons.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x869FD0 to the single `ret 4` at 0x86A1D3: [ebp+8] is the only stack argument, its +0x2C/+0x30 read as a vector bound at 0x869FEE and 0x86A1AE; the two calls at 0x86A10F (0x642010) and 0x86A1A9 (0x6423C0) each push [0x1a855fc], g_CCurrentGameState->+0xB8C[i] and [arg+0x2C][i]. findRefs --callers gives one direct call, from 0x65C02E inside CInGameIdler::Enter (functionStart 0x65A2B0). Inferred for the name and the role only. WHAT WOULD SHOW IT WRONG: an indirect caller (a vftable slot or a stored pointer) reaching it during play - only direct calls were searched.

addresses.name: ProvinceGraphics_UpdateResourcePictures
addresses.signature: void __stdcall ProvinceGraphics_UpdateResourcePictures(void* provinceGraphics, CMapProvince* province, void* owner)
addresses.comment: **A province's icons of crude oil, metal, energy and rare materials.** The province graphics' vector at +0x50 is sized to seven null pictures on first use, one per good. Nothing more where the template (+0xD4) has +0x13D clear. For each good g of the goods table at VA 0x170CF50 (stride 0x1C, pool order: supplies, fuel, money, oil, metal, energy, raremat) any old picture is taken down; then **only g = 3..6 and only where max_producing[g] (CMapProvince +0x294 + 4g) is above nought**, a billboard `resource_` + the table's key is made. **It stands at the position of the building in database slot g** - g_CBuildingDataBase +0xC[g], whose entry 0 is nobuilding, so the 3rd to 6th building of buildings.txt: CProvinceTemplate +0x258[that building's +0x54] less the label point (+0x5C/+0x60), set through the picture's slot 33, with the building's nudge (+0x268[index]) added to the transform's height (float 13). Then ProvinceGraphics_PlacePicture with raise 1 where the owner's +0x1DF0[province id] is set. So a resource icon stands on the same point as that building's picture (ProvinceGraphics_UpdatePictures places it the same way), and on (0, 0) - the map's corner - where positions.txt declares no position for that building. `ret 0xC`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-resourceicons.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x642010 to the single `ret 0xc` at 0x6423B1; ECX is never read before it is written, so __stdcall over three stack arguments. The goods gate is `cmp ebx,3/4/5/6` at 0x64210C..0x64211E and `cmp [edx+ebx*4+0x294],0; jle` at 0x642127, with ebx the loop index advanced beside the table pointer at 0x642389..0x64239B. The prefix `resource_` is the literal at VA 0x15CD648 (0x64213E); the four billboards resource_oil/_metal/_energy/_raremat exist in interface/mapitems.gfx and match the table's keys (FINDINGS-tradeui.md). The building is `mov edx,[eax+0xc]; mov ebx,[edx+ebx*4]` at 0x6421E4/0x6421EA with eax = [0x1A870D4], g_CBuildingDataBase; its +0x54 indexes [template+0x258] with `shl eax,4` at 0x64222D; the subtraction of +0x5C/+0x60 is at 0x64224A/0x642262; the nudge add at 0x642319..0x642337. CGoodsPool's goods start at +8 (record), so +0x294 is max_producing's supplies and +0x2A0 its crude oil. WHAT WOULD SHOW IT WRONG: buildings.txt reordered so that slot 4 names a building whose positions are declared, and metal icons still drawn at the map's corner in a running game - that would mean the index is not the database slot.

addresses.name: ProvinceGraphics_UpdateStrategicResourcePicture
addresses.signature: void __stdcall ProvinceGraphics_UpdateStrategicResourcePicture(void* provinceGraphics, CMapProvince* province, void* owner)
addresses.comment: **A province's strategic resource icon.** Any picture at the province graphics' +0x9C is taken down. Where the template has +0x13D set, the province's strategic resource (+0x18) is not null and answers true from its slot 14, a billboard `STRATEGIC_` + the resource's key (+0x30) is made, shown through its slot 13, hung with ProvinceGraphics_PlacePicture (raise 1) where the owner's +0x1DF0[province id] is set, and kept at +0x9C. **It is given no position** - unlike the goods' icons there is no slot 33 call - so it stands on the province's anchor, the label point (the bounding box's middle), which nothing in positions.txt moves. `ret 0xC`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-resourceicons.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x6423C0 to the `ret 0xc` at 0x64252B; three stack arguments, ECX not read first. The +0x9C teardown is 0x6423E6..0x642418; the gates are +0x13D at 0x64242B, the resource [arg2+0x18] non-null at 0x642438 and its slot 14 (+0x38) answering al at 0x642447; the prefix is the literal at VA 0x15CD654 (0x642455) joined to [resource+0x30] at 0x642473; slot 13 (+0x34) at 0x6424E2; PlacePicture (0x640CA0) at 0x6424FE; the store to +0x9C at 0x642503. Inferred for where it stands: that rests on the absence of a position call in this body, and the billboard factory (0x9C7D60, its slot 18) was not read. WHAT WOULD SHOW IT WRONG: the factory, or PlacePicture's raise path, setting a translation of its own - then the icon would not be on the label point.
